accessNotes: Style guide page (last updated 27 Aug 2025) fully readable as static HTML; palette hexes read from inline JS arrays and swatch classes. Exact ggplot values read from the urbnthemes R package source on GitHub via the GitHub API. The Highcharts theme was not consulted (R package was sufficient).
summary: Research-report / think-tank style for a nonprofit policy institute: clean, left-aligned, Lato-set charts with a bold title-case headline, italic sentence-case subtitle, cyan (#1696D2) as the dominant data colour with yellow/magenta for highlights, light grey horizontal gridlines, a black x-axis line with outside ticks and no y-axis line. Web charts carry 'Source:'/'Notes:' lines with bold lead-ins at bottom-left and the URBAN INSTITUTE tagline bottom-right.

colors.categoricalNotes: Order above is urbnthemes palette_urbn_main (cyan, yellow, black, gray, magenta, green, space gray, red), used by the R theme. The style guide states the brand hierarchy as main colors cyan, gray, black; secondary yellow and magenta ('used sparingly ... best for highlighting'); tertiary space gray, green, red ('used infrequently'). The guide's per-count recommended categorical sets (first set is what Excel add-in/R use): 2 groups blue+black (alternatives blue+gray, blue+yellow, black+yellow, blue+red - 'Use blue and red sparingly, usually only when comparing political data'); 3 groups blue, black, gray; 4 groups blue, black, gray, yellow; 5 groups blue, black, gray, yellow, magenta; 6 groups blue, black, gray, yellow, green, magenta; 8 groups: 'Consider consolidating categories ... Eight groups is really too many.' Keep categories to fewer than seven. One group: cyan; 'grey should not be used as it loses focus while magenta draws attention'. Do not use blue for men and pink for women; use e.g. yellow and cyan.
colors.notes: Shades of main colours (light->dark, 8 steps): cyan CFE8F3 A2D4EC 73BFE2 46ABDB 1696D2 12719E 0A4C6A 062635; gray F5F5F5 ECECEC E3E3E3 DCDBDB D2D2D2 9D9D9D 696969 353535; yellow FFF2CF FCE39E FDD870 FCCB41 FDBF11 E88E2D CA5800 843215; magenta F5CBDF EB99C2 E46AA7 E54096 EC008B AF1F6B 761548 351123; green DCEDD9 BCDEB4 98CF90 78C26D 55B748 408941 2C5C2D 1A2E19; space gray D5D5D4 ADABAC 848081 5C5859 332D2F 262223 1A1717 0E0C0D; red F8D5D4 F1AAA9 E9807D E25552 DB2B27 A4201D 6E1614 370B0A. Sequential count-specific (urbnthemes): 2 = A2D4EC,1696D2; 3 = A2D4EC,1696D2,0A4C6A; 4 = CFE8F3,73BFE2,1696D2,0A4C6A. A second diverging palette (magenta-green): 761548 AF1F6B E46AA7 EB99C2 BCDEB4 98CF90 408941 2C5C2D. Figure number colour #0A4B69. Tagline: 'Urban' #1696D2, 'Institute' #000000. Facet strip background #DEDDDD. Choropleths normally use the blue sequential ramp. 'Start With Gray' option: grey lines with colour for the highlighted series. Highlight in examples: a single yellow bar among cyan bars; black for an 'Overall' bar. WCAG 2.0 AA: palette swatches list white/black text that passes contrast.

axisTitle.placement: y-axis title horizontal above the y-axis labels, left-aligned (web layout spec); urbnthemes print theme rotates it 90°

typography.notes: Web sizes (px) / PDF sizes (pt): figure number Lato Regular ALL CAPS #0A4B69 11px/8pt; title Lato Black title case 20px/12pt; subtitle Lato Italic sentence case 16px/10pt; axis titles 12px/8.5pt; axis labels 12px/8.5pt; data labels 12px/8.5pt; legend text 14px/9.5pt; source and notes 11px/8pt. All text inside the figure uses sentence case. Tagline 'URBAN INSTITUTE' Lato Bold 9pt small caps with 0.5pt expanded tracking. urbnthemes base_size 8.5, title 12, subtitle 9.5, caption 7, axis titles italic, lineheight 0.9; facet strip text bold 9.5.

structure.gridlines: Horizontal only, solid #DEDDDD, 1px; no vertical or minor gridlines. Omit gridlines and y-axis labels when bars are directly labelled.
structure.axisLine: X-axis line solid #000000, 1pt; y-axis line not visible (horizontal bar charts show a black category baseline on the left).
structure.ticks: X-axis major tick marks outside; no minor ticks; no y-axis ticks.
structure.zeroLine: Bars always start at zero; x-axis line is the black baseline.
structure.yAxisTitle: Horizontal, italic, placed above the top of the y-axis labels and left-aligned with the chart (web spec)
structure.unitPlacement: Unit of measurement mentioned only once: in the subtitle or the y-axis title; tick labels can carry $ or % (e.g. '$1,400').
structure.notes: 'Left-align all elements' - title, subtitle, legend, y-axis title, source and notes share one left edge. urbnthemes plot.margin right = 12pt; title and subtitle 10pt bottom margin; legend margin 6pt top/bottom.

legend.placement: top - stretched across the chart between the subtitle and the y-axis title, horizontal, left-aligned
legend.directLabels: Preferred: 'When possible, directly label the data in the chart and omit the legend'; on line charts labels at the far right end of lines, evenly spaced and aligned.
legend.title: No legend title (urbnthemes legend.title blank)
legend.swatchShape: Short line (with marker when lines have markers) for line charts; square for bars; 10pt keys
legend.notes: Legend order must mirror the order of data in the chart. Legend text 14px.

marks.bars: Bar width about twice the gap between bars; one colour when all bars measure the same variable (highlight one in yellow or black for 'Overall'); no 3-D; always start at zero. Horizontal bars: category labels right-aligned and vertically centred. Stacked: series on the baseline should be most important or largest, unless logical ordering applies.
marks.lines: Default line size 1 (ggplot) in #1696D2; avoid markers on long time series (hollow circle markers used when lines are near-parallel); direct labels at line ends.
marks.pies: Allowed for part-to-whole but keep slices fewer than 5.
marks.notes: Dot plots limited to two dots per group. Maps: sf fill #1696D2 with white 0.1 borders.

labels.dataLabels: Placed as close as possible to the data point - just outside the ends of bars (grey text in example) or on line points; when bars have data labels, omit y-axis labels and gridlines.
labels.numberFormat: Comma thousands separators; currency prefix on tick labels ($1,400); percentages with one decimal (23.4%).
labels.notes: Abbreviations allowed in axis titles/labels if defined in notes ('FPL = federal poverty level'). Asterisks only for significance levels; superscript letters for cell notes.

furniture.title: Required. Short, active, title case, left-aligned; draw a conclusion where possible ('The Labor Force Participation Rate Has Declined for Men and Increased for Women'); subtitle (italic, sentence case) gives time period, frequency, units, geography. Optional figure number above in ALL CAPS #0A4B69 ('FIGURE 1').
furniture.source: Required on all figures. Bottom-left: 'Source: ...' then 'Notes: ...' on the following line, 11px, with 'Source' and 'Notes' in bold; full citation in Urban notes style or 'Authors' analysis.'
furniture.logo: Web charts: 'URBAN INSTITUTE' tagline bottom-right (Lato Bold 9pt small caps, 'URBAN' in #1696D2, 'INSTITUTE' black, letter-spaced); in PDFs added in Word at bottom right; omitted on government-funded products.
furniture.other: For PDF products title/subtitle/source/notes live in the Word document, not the chart image; for web all text is in a single image. Full width 760px (web) / 6.25in (PDF); half-width 3.13in in PDFs.

annotations: Explanatory text inside the graph to highlight values or explain how to read the chart; concise explanatory labels near data; 'Start With Gray' approach - grey context lines with colour for highlighted series.
layout: Full-width charts 760px on web, 6.25in in PDF (3.13in half-width; 8.67in landscape tables). Small multiples: same type, shape, size and identical scales. Everything left-aligned to a common edge.
accessibility: WCAG 2.0 AA contrast (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text); palette swatches labelled with passing white/black text; consider hashmarks, stripes or patterns as extra encodings; alt text required for all web charts (content and function, not description); 508-compliant tables with no merged/blank cells or spanner headings. Avoid blue/pink for gender; consider ordering of race/ethnicity groups (alphabetical in example; see Do No Harm guide).

chartTypes.notes: Consider text, a big aggregate number or a table instead of a chart when appropriate.

distinctiveRules.rule: Left-align all elements: title, subtitle, legend, y-axis title, source and notes share the same left edge.
Title in Lato Black 20px, title case; subtitle Lato Italic 16px, sentence case; everything inside the plot in sentence case.
distinctiveRules.quote: Title Lato Black ... 20px; Subtitle Lato Italic ... Sentence ... 16px

distinctiveRules.rule: Y-axis line invisible with no tick marks; x-axis line solid black 1pt with outside major ticks and no minor ticks.
distinctiveRules.quote: Y-axis line should not be visible, Major tick marks: None ... X-axis line Solid #000000 weight: 1pt Major tick marks: Outside

distinctiveRules.rule: Y-axis title is italic 12px, horizontal, sitting above the y-axis labels at top-left; x-axis title italic, centred below the axis.
distinctiveRules.quote: Y-axis title Sentence case Lato Italic 12px

distinctiveRules.rule: Legend stretched horizontally across the top between subtitle and y-axis title, no legend title, order mirroring the data; direct labels preferred.
distinctiveRules.quote: Stretch legends across the top of the chart between the title/subtitle and y-axis label.

distinctiveRules.rule: Source and Notes lines bottom-left at 11px with the words 'Source' and 'Notes' in bold.
distinctiveRules.quote: Bold the words “Source” and “Notes,” as well as any statistical significance notes.

distinctiveRules.rule: URBAN INSTITUTE tagline bottom-right on web charts: Lato Bold 9pt small caps, letter-spaced, 'URBAN' in #1696D2 and 'INSTITUTE' in black.
distinctiveRules.quote: Urban charts posted on the web also include an Urban tagline/logo in the lower-right corner

distinctiveRules.rule: Cyan #1696D2 is the default single-series colour; highlight one category in yellow #FDBF11 (or black for an 'Overall' bar); yellow and magenta used sparingly for highlighting.
distinctiveRules.quote: yellow and magenta should be used sparingly; these colors are best for highlighting purposes

distinctiveRules.rule: Bar width about twice the gap between bars; bars always start at zero; when bars carry data labels at their ends, drop gridlines and value-axis labels.
distinctiveRules.quote: The width of the bars should be about twice the width of the space between the bars ... Urban style is to omit y-axis labels and gridlines

distinctiveRules.rule: Horizontal bar category labels right-aligned and vertically centred on the bar.
distinctiveRules.quote: right-align the category labels and center them vertically

distinctiveRules.rule: Fewer than seven categories; pies fewer than 5 slices; avoid dual axes and 3-D.
distinctiveRules.quote: our standard is to keep the number of categories in any graph to fewer than seven

distinctiveRules.rule: Figure number above the title in ALL CAPS Lato Regular 11px, colour #0A4B69.
distinctiveRules.quote: Figure number Lato Regular #0A4B69 ... ALL CAPS ... 11px

referenceImages.describes: Annotated web chart template, 760px wide. Title top-left in Lato 20px (shown regular weight in the wireframe), italic 16px subtitle below, legend row with short thick line swatches (yellow 'Black, non-Hispanic', black 'White, non-Hispanic') in 14px. Y-axis title 'Tax programs' in italic 12px sitting horizontally above the y labels at the left edge. Five light grey (#DEDDDD 1px) horizontal gridlines; y labels left of the grid; no y-axis line or ticks. Black 1pt x-axis line with outside tick marks and 12px labels; italic x-axis title centred below. A pink dashed guide marks a single left alignment edge. Bottom-left 'Source:' and 'Notes:' paragraphs in 11px with bold lead-ins; 'URBAN · INSTITUTE' letter-spaced tagline bottom-right with URBAN in blue.

Horizontal bar chart 'State and Local Direct General Expenditures' - title bold/black, left-aligned, title case; subtitle regular (not italic here) 'Share of total, by functional category, fiscal year 2021'. Bars cyan #1696D2 sorted descending, one bar highlighted in yellow #FDBF11. Category labels right-aligned to a thin black vertical baseline; no gridlines, no value axis; data labels in dark grey just past bar ends (23.4%). Bar thickness roughly twice the gaps. Bottom-left 'Source:' and 'Note:' with bold lead-ins; 'URBAN INSTITUTE' tagline bottom-right with URBAN in cyan, letter-spaced caps.

Line chart with a long bold title-case headline stating the finding, regular subtitle with units ('Outstanding loans in billions of dollars'). Legend across the top, centred-left, with line+hollow-circle swatches; series cyan, black, light grey, yellow, each with white-filled circle markers. Light grey horizontal gridlines, y labels left with $ and commas ($1,400), no y axis line; black x-axis line with outside ticks and two-year labels. Source/Note bottom-left with bold lead-ins, URBAN INSTITUTE tagline bottom-right.
